summary: Nine metres of kerb beside a junction, too short for a van.
reasons: Beside junction with No Stopping signs

drivers.seclusion: Shopfronts directly behind; apartments 30 m or more away, so seclusion would be fine if a van fitted.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 9 m of kerb, ending at a signalised side-street corner; a van would overhang the junction.
drivers.traffic: Busy main road through the shopping strip.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time signs at both ends; 2P signs apply to daytime only.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at both ends
sun_shade: Open to the sky; shopfront to the south shades the kerb in the afternoon.
